[Context: 25. It is difficult to find consistent data on development partner expenditure on health. Official government statistics]
state that the government appropriated VT 1,534,639,563 from its own resources to the Ministry of Health in 2012
(with actual expenses then being VT 1,562,160,907). Those same official statistics show that development partners
then provided VT 419,824,089 to the MOH in 2012 or 21.18 percent total government expenditure on health.
However some separate MOH official data sets state that total development partner financing was VT 890,084,124

in 2012, bringing the total government expenditure (appropriated and development partners) to VT 2,424,723,697.
